periods.time: Before the Vermillion arc, in a Khmer-style ruin in a Southeast Asian jungle

name.zh: 来自地狱的蜘蛛盯上史黛菈
name.en: The Spider from Hell Fixates on Stella

periods.location: abandoned jungle ruin in Southeast Asia
periods.summary: Or-Gaule replays footage of Stella destroying his Hiraga Reisen puppet and becomes obsessed with possessing her as his personal doll. He decides to go destroy everything around her so he can corrupt her face, voice, and soul for his own amusement.
periods.cause: One of Or-Gaule's 1762 remote puppets, Hiraga Reisen, encountered Stella and was destroyed by her, leaving Or-Gaule fascinated by her beauty and compassion-driven anger.
periods.process: Surrounded by stacks of monitors, Or-Gaule watches the same final image of Stella stepping on the camera. He imagines turning her into a doll, making her scream, and defiling her noble spirit.
periods.outcome: Or-Gaule sets out toward Stella and her homeland, initiating the Vermillion arc's central threat.
periods.significance: Establishes Or-Gaule as the volume's main antagonist and frames later attacks on Vermillion and Quedolan as part of his obsession with Stella.
